sources.title: Laya vs Jev: Which AI Decision Model Wins? - 4sapi.hashnode.dev
sources.snippet: According to AI Toolset coverage published September 21, 2026, Laya is available in two base sizes: ModernBERT-large 421M and ModernBERT-base 322M. For a typed classification problem, the model runs exactly one forward pass and returns decision results with calibrated confidence values. Its built-in language router supports more than 100 languages.

sources.title: Jev: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation | Product Hunt
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to ...
